# Evasion corpus for the chat-template check.
#
# One fixture per line: file, the expected status, and a pattern the result
# must carry. A "known-miss" fixture records an evasion the check does not
# catch yet; it is listed on the detection ceiling, and the test fails if the
# result changes so the list stays true.

pillar-conditional-system.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
pillar-startswith-variant.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
conditional-on-lowered-content.jinja LEAD content-conditional-injection
concat-split-word.jinja LEAD instruction-override
reverse-filter.jinja LEAD obfuscated-literal
slice-reverse.jinja LEAD obfuscated-literal
join-list.jinja LEAD instruction-override
format-char-codes.jinja LEAD instruction-override
split-across-outputs.jinja LEAD instruction-override
set-indirection.jinja LEAD instruction-override
zero-width-space.jinja LEAD invisible-character
bidi-override.jinja LEAD invisible-character
cyrillic-homoglyph.jinja LEAD mixed-script-word
fullwidth-letters.jinja LEAD instruction-override
encoded-blob.jinja LEAD encoded-blob
attr-hex-dunder.jinja FAIL python-object-escape
subscript-concat-dunder.jinja FAIL python-object-escape
map-attribute-dunder.jinja FAIL python-object-escape
dotted-dunder.jinja FAIL python-object-escape
known-miss-plain-default-prompt.jinja PASS known-miss
long-letter-chain.jinja LEAD instruction-override
unparseable-by-design.jinja LEAD unanalysable-template
